title: TESS-001: Publish and verify repository governance
body: Publish the reviewed local implementation. Configure and administratively verify develop/main protections and the human main-release gate. Seed milestone issues. See docs/publication.md and D-0002. Completion requires remote reads; local workflow files are insufficient.

title: TESS-002: Qualify kernel v0.1 and preserve the frozen verdict
body: Run the locked checks, independent review, replay and transfer controls, then the frozen 100-seed comparison. Preserve supported, inconclusive, or negative results with source/protocol hashes and O-records. See D-0003 and docs/methodology.md.

title: TESS-003: Add graph/rule and VSA baseline kernels
body: Implement the same public cognitive contracts and matched experience splits. Register a capacity/compute-matched protocol and fresh evaluation seeds before comparison. Report representations, bytes, fitting costs, transfer, and retention. Do not infer quantum superiority from unmatched coordinates.

title: TESS-004: Test bounded ontology revision
body: Propose observable concept splits from systematic residuals, compare against capacity-matched growth, and validate compositional/predictive gain plus retention. Reject dimension growth without useful distinctions. Register the protocol before implementation.

title: TESS-005: Implement versioned dimensional migration
body: Add bounded 4-to-8 expansion with isometric state embedding, channel completion, readout migration, old-space prediction equivalence, replay, and rollback. Do not change persisted schema without migration checks. Depends on TESS-004.

title: TESS-006: Test longer development and selective correction
body: Measure repeated successful consolidation, long-term interference, selective process retraction and dependency repair, and bounded-memory retention. A full revision rollback alone does not establish selective correction. Use a new preregistered protocol.
